CustomField.description: API name of a Custom Permission that suppresses this one binding for any user who holds it, e.g. Bypass_Trigger_Actions. Unlike Is Disabled, this is assignable at runtime via a permission set, so an integration user or a data load can skip this handler without a metadata deployment. Leave blank for no permission-based bypass. For a permission owned by another package, include its namespace.
CustomField.label: Bypass Permission
